gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Stonevein amulet Tree and go east.
• Home teleport to Wendlewick and take a canoe to either:
• Amberfell 4, head east over the barrier (next to Ash).
• Heathervein 5, head south.
• Fairy ring code DLP to Amberfell, head east.
• Travel to the Moonrise Dig Site, walk east through Amberfell.
• Without access to the canoe stations or fairy ring network:
• # Home teleport to Wendlewick.
• # Head east to Amberfell using the bridge south of Ivar, King of Bones.
• # Climb over the barricade east of Amberfell.
• # Head east.
